title: FinanceFlow
description: An intelligent personal finance and expense tracking SaaS with AI-powered insights, automated categorization, and goal-based savings planning.
longDescription: FinanceFlow reimagines personal finance management with clean UX and AI-driven intelligence. Connect your bank accounts, track spending patterns, set savings goals, and receive personalized insights. The platform features automated transaction categorization, smart budgeting tools, investment tracking, and predictive cash flow analysis — all in a beautiful, intuitive interface.
features: Multi-account aggregation via secure bank connections
Smart budget planner with real-time alerts
Predictive cash flow and expense forecasting
Beautiful analytics dashboard with charts and trends
